Starlink saves lives

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Elon Musk megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: DogeDesigner (@cb_doge); megjelent: 2026-11-03T03:56:39+00:00; link: https://x.com/cb_doge/status/2117465958025674806; média: 1 kép]
Starlink helped save FIVE lives in the Atlantic. ♥️

Their boat, Karolina Viking, was filling with water. Its power systems were failing. Rescuers couldn’t reach them by radio or satellite phone.

The sailors shared their location with rescuers through Starlink, helping another yacht find them.

All five were rescued from their liferaft and brought safely aboard.

Starlink helped turn a desperate situation into five lives saved. This is what a lifeline from space looks like.
